feeds.title: The Natural Parent Magazine » Pregnancy & Birth
feeds.description: The Natural Parent Magazine's Pregnancy & Birth section offers a wealth of articles aimed at supporting expectant and new parents through various stages of pregnancy and early parenthood. The magazine is led by a dedicated team, including authors like Kylee Harris, Jeanelle Harvey-Bridges, and Dr. Dawn Kingston, who bring a range of expertise in health, midwifery, and holistic care. The publication emphasizes natural, holistic approaches to parenting, providing resources on topics from safe exercises during pregnancy to chiropractic care for families.

feeds.title: Cutest Baby Shower Ideas
feeds.description: The Cutest Baby Shower Ideas Blog keeps you up-to-date with all additions and changes to the cutest-baby-shower-ideas.com web site. Anytime we add cute new baby shower ideas, we will post them here! Modern Baby Shower Ideas for hosting a baby shower for a girl, boy, gender reveal! Printable baby shower games, punch recipes, baby shower menu ideas etc.

feeds.title: PregActive Mommy Blog
feeds.description: The trusted online PregActive mommy blog for for pregnancy and moms. The mommy blog for prenatal, postpartum workouts, exercises, classes #pregnancy #momlife

feeds.title: Obstetric Excellence Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Gary Sykes is a specialist obstetrician based in Sydney, Australia. In his blog, he covers everything from news to clients' stories to tips and tricks surrounding pregnancy and obstetrics. Read our latest blog posts about a range of pregnancy topics including pregnancy care, infections, labor & delivery, breastfeeding & fees.

feeds.title: The Breastfeeding Tea Co Blog
feeds.description: The Breastfeeding Tea Co provides simple, natural, and effective teas to assist with breastfeeding challenges. Hi, Jordana, the founder of The Breastfeeding Tea Co. I created our first breastfeeding tea after the birth of my 3rd child who was experiencing a lot of difficulty latching, had silent reflux, and was a really difficult baby to feed. My personal purpose is to support as many mothers and babies as we can around the world. My promise to you is that we will always be here, and we will do everything that we can to help support and care for you and your baby.

feeds.title: The Healthy Mummy
feeds.description: Are you ready to change your life? Pregnancy diet plan, tips and advice for The Healthy Mummy. From labour, to stretch marks, fascinating baby names and even the meals to get prepared before your bundle of joy arrives! Plus, we give you the lowdown on everything you need to know when expecting. Even those stories no one tells you.

feeds.title: My Child Magazine
feeds.description: This is a place to find not only wholesome and simple parenting reads and information, but encouragement, humour and motivation for your journey as a caregiver. At My Child Mag, it is truly our greatest heart's desire to help others find encouragement and fulfilment through the best digital magazine experience possible.

feeds.title: BodyFabulous Blog
feeds.description: Learn to cherish your body during pregnancy and postpartum with Dahlas Certified Pregnancy Exercise Specialist's Bodyfabulous Pregnancy Blog.

feeds.title: New Born Baby
feeds.description: Newborn Baby blog is an information site for parents either trying to conceive a baby, pregnant with a baby or already enjoying their newborn child. This blog will help you to understand the journey that you are on and help you to make informed decisions along the way.

feeds.title: Nourish Baby Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2012, Nourish Baby helps parents enjoy a healthy pregnancy, positive labor and birth, and early parenting success. We are a complete guide to pregnancy, birth, and the first 3 years of your baby's life - personalized for exactly where you are on your parenting journey. Check out our courses as well as read the latest in all things pregnancy, baby, and toddler related.

feeds.title: The Pregnancy Naturopath
feeds.description: The Pregnancy Naturopath Melbourne is one of the best naturopaths in Melbourne and is currently based in Moonee Ponds. With over 20 years experience in women's health including midwifery, pregnancy naturopathy, delivery suites, postnatal wards, neonatal nurseries and specialist clinics, I understand how natural therapies can work alongside western medicine. A healthy pregnancy, baby and family is always the goal, so I only use products that are safe and trusted.

feeds.title: Hayley Carberry Photography - Canberra Newborn Baby Family Children Portrait Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hayley Carberry is a children photographer and family photographer specialising in babies, children and family. She works in Canberra, and surrounding areas and travels to Adelaide regularly.

feeds.title: The Newborn Studio Blog
feeds.description: We are a boutique home studio situated in Murrumba Downs, on the Northside of Brisbane, offering custom newborn and baby portraiture. The Newborn Studio specialise in documenting everything about your newborn, including your pregnancy, newborn session, and baby's milestone sessions, until baby turns one.

feeds.title: Melbourne Pregnancy and Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy Blog
feeds.description: Melbourne Pregnancy and Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy was created by Rebecca Liberatore and Karina Coffey who had a combined vision of creating a Specialist Pregnancy and Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy Clinic in Melbourne's North West. Both Rebecca and Karina have an extensive background working in large maternity hospitals and this acute hospital experience significantly enhances their work at Melbourne Pregnancy and Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy, providing a comprehensive understanding of the acute presentation of patients immediately post-natal through the full continuum of recovery.

feeds.title: Baby Domain » Pregnancy
feeds.description: Babyology is an Australian parenting site that provides a supportive and trusted community for over one million parents and parents-to-be. With information and advice that celebrates the parenting journey in all its shades, Babyology offers original points of view that bring to life the very real, and sometimes challenging, world of parenting where daily life with children is something to be cherished and celebrated.

feeds.title: Eve Health Blog
feeds.description: Eve Health has been proudly providing excellence in women's healthcare in Brisbane since 2007. Here at Eve, we believe in personalised, comprehensive service tailored to your gynaecology, fertility and pregnancy-related needs. Our team of specialists have a wealth of knowledge and experience, enabling Eve to offer the highest quality care to women of all ages.

feeds.title: The BubHub - Pregnancy
feeds.description: The Bub Hub is Australia's favourite pregnancy and parenting portal with 600,000 visitors each month. Informative pregnancy blog for Australian parents-to-be - latest pregnancy news, pregnancy advice, product news and some witty stuff too from Australia's leading pregnancy, baby and parenting website.

feeds.title: Pregnancy Babies & Children's Expo
feeds.description: Informative, fun and extremely convenient, our Expos save you hours of time & energy trawling for information yourself. Public exhibition of pregnancy, birth, baby, toddler and preschooler suppliers and services - Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth & Adelaide.
